name: Science Fiction
description: Ships, stations, and the strangeness of the future.
tone: Curious, grounded, and a little lonely. Technology is ordinary to the people who use it. Wonder and danger come from the unknown. Touchstones: working-class space fiction, first-contact stories.

narration.style: Precise, concrete detail about machines and spaces. Explain technology only through use. Keep jargon light and consistent.

artStyle: cinematic concept art, cool teal and amber lighting, used-future detail
